Store Manager Job at DualCore Careers




        
    

        
        DualCore Careers is a recruitment and career support company dedicated to connecting employers with highly skilled remote and on-site professionals. We help businesses find the right talent while also empowering job seekers through CV optimization, LinkedIn enhancement, and career development services. Our goal is to bridge the gap between great talent and great opportunities.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Store Manager 

Job Location: Abulegba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Hours: 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM

About the Role
     

            
    




	We are seeking a responsible, organised, and experienced Store Manager to oversee the daily operations of a skincare store located at 161 Ekoro Road, Abulegba.
	The ideal candidate must be able to manage the store effectively, maintain accurate records, supervise daily activities, attend to customers professionally, and ensure the smooth running of the business.
	This role requires someone who is reliable, committed, and ready to work on a long-term basis.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the store.
	Ensure the store is opened and closed promptly according to the required working hours.
	Supervise staff and ensure they carry out their duties effectively.
	Maintain accurate records of daily sales, expenses, stock, and other store activities.
	Monitor inventory and ensure proper stock management.
	Track products coming into and going out of the store.
	Identify low-stock items and report them to management promptly.
	Ensure the store is clean, organised, and properly presented at all times.
	Attend to customers professionally and resolve customer complaints where necessary.
	Monitor sales performance and provide regular reports to management.
	Ensure proper handling and accountability of cash and sales proceeds.
	Prevent avoidable losses, stock discrepancies, and operational issues.
	Ensure staff adhere to company policies and procedures.
	Report any significant issues or concerns to management promptly.


Requirements


	Previous experience in store management, retail management, or a similar position is preferred.
	Must be highly organised and able to keep proper records.
	Must have good communication and customer service skills.
	Must be responsible, trustworthy, and capable of handling store operations independently.
	Must be able to supervise and manage staff effectively.
	Must be comfortable working with sales and inventory records.
	Must be able to work under pressure and handle multiple responsibilities.
	Must be punctual and reliable.
	Must demonstrate a genuine commitment to the role and be willing to work on a long-term basis.
	Candidates who anticipate leaving the role shortly due to school or other commitments may not be considered.
	Must reside within close proximity to 161 Ekoro Road, Abulegba.
	Candidates living far from the store will not be considered due to the working hours and location.
	Candidate’s current residential location must be clearly stated on the CV.


Salary
N100,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Updated CV – clearly stating your current residential location, and  Cover Letter – explaining your experience, suitability for the role, and interest in the position to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Important: Only candidates who reside within close proximity to 161 Ekoro Road, Abulegba and meet the stated requirements will be shortlisted.

Fiber Coordinator Job at Cobranet Limited




        
    

        
        Cobranet Limited; a reputable organization incorporated in 2003 and provides internet solutions. Our footprint and range of products have grown immensely since incorporation and we are proud to provide every segment of society with a reliable link to the digital universe.

Our entire network topology is rugged, dynamic and fully redundant with negligible downtimes: content showing extremely high availability exceeding 99.5%. Our promise is to continue providing innovative solutions at the best feature-to-price and service-to-price ratio.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Fiber Coordinator 

Job Location: Lekki Phase 1, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Job Description


	Manage the schedule of field Fiber Engineers.
	Handle escalated complaints from other departments.
	Distribute the escalated jobs based on priority and urgency.
	Provide remote technical support for the engineers on field.
	Monitor the quality of Jobs our engineers are doing on the field.
	Make sure the engineers are sending their reports on time.
	Report directly to the HOD.


Education and qualifications


	BSc / HND in Computer engineering/Telecommunications
	4+ years of technical experience in telecommunication field operations
	Strong communications skills both written and verbal.
	Independent problem solver combined with strong team orientation.
	Capable of making solid, fact-based decisions under pressure.
	Ability to work in high pressure technical environment.
	Knowledgeable in Cisco routers and switches configuration.
	Cisco Certified Network Associates (CCNA) is a must
	Excellent understanding of wireless communications.
	Experience: 4 years and above.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail. 

Note: Only qualified candidates will be contacted.

title: Job Openings at Sterling Gate Services Limited
content:
Sterling Gate Services Limited is an indigenous consulting firm established in 2017, providing structured and tailored support to organisations across multiple sectors. We partner with companies strengthening HR functions, recruiting top talent, and managing facilities, office supplies, catering, and general support services, aligned with business objectives and professional best practices. Supporting People, Places & Processes. 

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

 1.) Business Development Executive / Consultant

Job Location: Lagos / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	Sterling Gate Services is a growing business support and people solutions company seeking a commercially driven Business Development Executive/Consultant to build and grow our corporate client base.
	This is a startup environment, so we're looking for someone who can independently prospect, open doors, generate opportunities and convert them into meetings, proposals and contracts.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and prospect potential corporate clients.
	Generate leads through cold calls, LinkedIn, email, networking and referrals.
	Identify and engage decision-makers across HR, Operations, Administration and Procurement.
	Book qualified client meetings.
	Understand client needs and recommend relevant Sterling Gate services.
	Maintain and actively manage the sales pipeline.
	Follow up on leads, meetings and proposals through to conversion.
	Provide market intelligence and contribute to business growth strategies.


Key Performance Measures


	Qualified prospects generated
	Meetings booked
	Proposals/opportunities generated
	New clients acquired
	Revenue generated
	Pipeline value
	CRM/reporting discipline.


Requirements


	2–5 years of experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, Corporate Sales or Professional Services.
	Proven ability to generate leads independently and close business.
	Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
	Confident with cold outreach and engaging senior decision-makers.
	Target-driven, persistent and self-motivated.
	Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
	Experience selling recruitment, HR, outsourcing, facilities, procurement or other professional services is an advantage.


Compensation

 2.) Business Development Executive / Consultant

Employment Type: Full-time

	Sterling Gate Services is a growing business support and people solutions company seeking a commercially driven Business Development Executive/Consultant to build and grow our corporate client base.
	This is a startup environment, so we're looking for someone who can independently prospect, open doors, generate opportunities and convert them into meetings, proposals and contracts.


Key Responsibilities


	Identify and prospect potential corporate clients.
	Generate leads through cold calls, LinkedIn, email, networking and referrals.
	Identify and engage decision-makers across HR, Operations, Administration and Procurement.
	Book qualified client meetings.
	Understand client needs and recommend relevant Sterling Gate services.
	Maintain and actively manage the sales pipeline.
	Follow up on leads, meetings and proposals through to conversion.
	Provide market intelligence and contribute to business growth strategies.


Key Performance Measures


	Qualified prospects generated
	Meetings booked
	Proposals/opportunities generated
	New clients acquired
	Revenue generated
	Pipeline value
	CRM/reporting discipline.

	2–5 years of experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, Corporate Sales or Professional Services.
	Proven ability to generate leads independently and close business.
	Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
	Confident with cold outreach and engaging senior decision-makers.
	Target-driven, persistent and self-motivated.
	Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced startup environment.
	Experience selling recruitment, HR, outsourcing, facilities, procurement or other professional services is an advantage.


Compensation
Commission-based / Performance-driven:


	The structure will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
	This is an opportunity to grow with a young business and potentially take on greater commercial responsibility as Sterling Gate expands.


Application Closing Date: 26th August, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Job Location: Anambra, Cross River, Delta, Edo, Imo, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Remote
Work Schedule: Monday – Saturday

Job Summary


	Sterling Gate Services Limited is recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing technology and digital commerce company seeking ambitious, results-driven Marketing & Growth Officers to drive  business growth within their assigned states.


Key Responsibilities


	Drive customer acquisition and app growth.
	Onboard businesses, merchants, and strategic partners.
	Execute activations and marketing campaigns.
	Build partnerships and generate revenue opportunities.
	Create localized content to increase brand visibility.
	Submit timely reports and market insights.


Requirements


	2–4 years' experience in Marketing, Business Development, Sales, or Partnerships.
	Strong networking, negotiation, and communication skills.
	Proven ability to meet growth targets.
	Must reside in Rivers, Cross Rivers, Imo, Anambra, Edo, or Delta State.
	Experience in technology, fintech, e-commerce, telecommunications, or startups is an added advantage.


Application Closing Date: 25th September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using your preferred Job Location as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
